snippet.title: Gweilo 1886 | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Question Family. Question Establishment. Question Sanity.

Explore Gweilo 1886 on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5409320/Gweilo_1886/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=debut&utm_content=gameplay-trailer

A Victorian-Era Hong Kong mystery adventure. An ex-priest opium addict, his father's dying request + a precocious feline. From Buttermilk Studios.

Question people. Inspect objects. Explore back streets. Uncover what families, institutions and bad habits keep hidden.

For Windows 10/11. English-language game.

Listen to the Original Soundtrack Here:
https://soundcloud.com/gweilo1886

#Gweilo1886 #Steam #MysteryGame
